# Append

Adds a value to the end of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Append(items, value)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to add to, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `value` | any | The value to add, of any type, null included. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding the elements of items in order, followed by value. Never null.

## Example

`Append([1, 2], 3)` returns `[1, 2, 3]`.
